name: 280-ZZZAP sound circuits
drawing: 280 ZZZAP Game Logic P.C. 0610-00907A, which this site does not hold -- via MAME's netlist, compared with its near copy, Laguna Racer A622 (doc 2e04e6b435f0)
revision: 280-ZZZAP game logic board, sound section: engine (two LM3900 oscillators into an MC3340 attenuator), skid and crash noise, and the mix.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist: the engine, skid and crash sounds and the final mix, up to the audio power amplifier. The CPU's sound latches (F4, F5) are ports; the rest of the game logic board is not in MAME.
